name: The Morning Rush
description: Regulars at the corner café each ordered a different drink and a different pastry one busy morning. Work out who had what.
clues: The Espresso order's price is between the order in the Rose mug and Edith.
Cara goes with none of Cortado, Crimson, or $10.
The Cortado order's price is exactly $4 more than the order in the Rose mug.
The Mocha order's price is exactly $4 more than the order in the Onyx mug.
The order in the Amber mug's price is between Ava and the Mocha order.
Edith's price is higher than both the Cortado order and the order in the Onyx mug.
